protocol.uncertainty: Paired circular residual block bootstrap, with full finite-candidate adstock/saturation selection and constrained coefficients refitted. Original observed-sales denominator fixed for contributions.
protocol.transformSensitivity: Top 20 full-fit transform candidates by SSE, descriptive sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval.
protocol.holdout: Final 12 months evaluated using parameters and coefficients fitted on preceding 48 analysis months; full 60-month refit for reporting.
protocol.causalLimitation: Synthetic same-family generator favors recovery. No causal identification or real-client conclusion. Bootstrap support is not a calibrated probability of real-world gain.
